title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy

claims.claim: Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang, eşini aldattığını Pazar günü kabul ederek özür diledi.

evidence.quote: On Sunday, Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children.

claims.claim: Nvidia, Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddialar üzerine bağımsız bir soruşturma başlattı.

evidence.quote: US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the reports.

claims.claim: Alice Huang, Singapur merkezli veri merkezi firması Megaspeed'de üst düzey yönetici olarak görev yapmıştır.

evidence.quote: Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed.

claims.claim: Nvidia, 1993 yılında Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky ve Curtis Priem tarafından kurulmuştur.

evidence.quote: Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games.
Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993

claims.claim: Bloomberg Milyarderler Endeksi'ne göre Jensen Huang'ın tahmini serveti 155 milyar dolardır.

evidence.quote: He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (Â£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index.

claims.claim: Nvidia'nın piyasa değeri yaklaşık 4,5 trilyon dolardır.

evidence.quote: Currently worth $4.5tn (Â£3.4tn), Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies ever.

claims.claim: Jensen Huang ve eşi Lori Mills 1985 yılında evlenmiştir.

evidence.quote: They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer.
They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia

claims.claim: Jen-Hsun ve Lori Huang Vakfı'nın varlıklarının 9 milyar dolardan fazla olduğu tahmin edilmektedir.
